print("=== S3 OBSERVATIONS ===")
for d in sorted(p for p in root.iterdir() if p.is_dir()):
    obs = d / "observation.json"
    inv = d / "invocation.json"
    flags = []
    flags.append("obs" if obs.exists() else "NO_OBS")
    flags.append("inv" if inv.exists() else "NO_INV")
    flags.append("stdout" if (d / "stdout.jsonl").exists() else "NO_STDOUT")
    data = None
    src = None
    if obs.exists():
        data = json.loads(obs.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        src = "obs"
    elif inv.exists():
        data = json.loads(inv.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        src = "inv"
    extra = ""
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        if src == "obs":
            extra = " keys=" + ",".join(sorted(data.keys()))
        for k in ("case", "exitCode", "timedOut", "verdict", "result"):
            if k in data:
                extra += f" {k}={data[k]!r}"
        text = data.get("input")
        if text is None and "command" in data:
            text = data.get("command")
        if text is not None:
            extra += " text=" + repr(text)[:220]
    print(d.name + ": " + " ".join(flags) + extra)

rt = Path(r"docs/releases/runtime/v0.14.0")
print("\n=== v0.14.0 ENVELOPES ===")
if rt.exists():
    for p in sorted(rt.glob("*.json")):
        data = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        unit = data.get("unit", {})
        inv = data.get("invocation", {})
        cmd = inv.get("command")
        result = data.get("result") or data.get("outcome") or data.get("verdict")
        print(p.name)
        print("  unit", unit)
        print("  captured", data.get("capturedAt"))
        print("  result_keys", sorted((data.get("result") or {}).keys()) if isinstance(data.get("result"), dict) else type(data.get("result")).__name__)
        # print top-level keys
        print("  keys", ",".join(sorted(data.keys())))
        if isinstance(cmd, list) and len(cmd) >= 3:
            print("  prompt", repr(cmd[2])[:300])
        reads = data.get("reads") or data.get("filesRead") or data.get("toolReads")
        if reads:
            print("  reads", reads)

    data = None
    src = None
    if obs.exists():
        data = json.loads(obs.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        src = "obs"
    elif inv.exists():
        data = json.loads(inv.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        src = "inv"
    extra = ""
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        if src == "obs":
            extra = " keys=" + ",".join(sorted(data.keys()))
        for k in ("case", "exitCode", "timedOut", "verdict", "result"):
            if k in data:
                extra += f" {k}={data[k]!r}"
        text = data.get("input")
        if text is None and "command" in data:

    print(d.name + ": " + " ".join(flags) + extra)

rt = Path(r"docs/releases/runtime/v0.14.0")
print("\n=== v0.14.0 ENVELOPES ===")
if rt.exists():
    for p in sorted(rt.glob("*.json")):
        data = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        unit = data.get("unit", {})

        print(p.name)
        print("  unit", unit)
        print("  captured", data.get("capturedAt"))

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    h.update(path.read_bytes())
    return h.hexdigest()

files = [
    Path("docs/architecture/governance-guide.md"),
    Path("docs/architecture/principles.md"),
    Path("docs/architecture/workspace-protocol.md"),
    Path("docs/vision/alignment.md"),
    Path("docs/templates/governance-entry.md"),
    Path("skills/AGENTS.template.md"),
    Path("skills/install/claude/AGENTS.md"),
    Path("skills/install/copilot/copilot-instructions.md"),
]
print("=== SIZES ===")
for p in files:
    if not p.exists():
        # find copilot instructions
        print("MISSING", p)
        continue
    data = p.read_bytes()
    text = data.decode("utf-8")
    print(f"{p}: bytes={len(data)} lines={text.count(chr(10)) + (0 if text.endswith(chr(10)) else 1)} sha={sha256(p)[:16]}")

print("\n=== ENTRY vs ENVELOPE ===")
env = json.loads(Path("docs/releases/runtime/v0.14.0/grok-build-cli-govern-2026-11-03.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
current = {str(p).replace("\\", "/"): sha256(p) for p in [
    Path("docs/architecture/governance-guide.md"),
    Path("docs/architecture/principles.md"),
    Path("docs/architecture/workspace-protocol.md"),
    Path("docs/vision/alignment.md"),
    Path("docs/templates/governance-entry.md"),
    Path("skills/prompts/05-independent-audit.md"),
]}
for src in env["behaviorSources"]:
    path = src["path"]
    if path in current:
        print(path, "MATCH" if current[path] == src["sha256"] else "DIFF", "env", src["sha256"][:12], "now", current[path][:12])

matrix = json.loads(Path("docs/contracts/skills-consumer-compatibility-matrix.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
print("\n=== MATRIX CELLS ===", matrix["candidateRevision"])
for c in matrix["consumers"]:
    eps = c.get("entrypoints") or []
    print(c["id"], "host", (c.get("host") or {}).get("version"), "eps", [(e.get("name"), len(e.get("evidence") or [])) for e in eps])

print("\n=== v0.14 files ===")
for p in sorted(Path("docs/releases/runtime/v0.14.0").glob("*.json")):
    print(p.name)

# load sentence count outside attachments
needle = "按需加载：治理根预检通过后"
count = 0
paths = []
for p in Path(".").rglob("*"):
    if not p.is_file():
        continue
    if any(part in {"attachments", ".git", "__pycache__", "artifacts", "dist"} for part in p.parts):
        continue
    if p.suffix.lower() not in {".md", ".py"}:
        continue
    try:
        text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except Exception:
        continue
    if needle in text:
        count += 1
        paths.append(str(p).replace("\\", "/"))
print("\nload-sentence files", count)
for path in paths:
    print(path)
